description: Reference year of the income data, stored as January 1 of that year (1976-01-01 to 2024-01-01). Income refers to the full calendar year.

Geography name as published by Statistics Canada: Canada, the provinces, the territories, official regional groupings, and in low_income_statistics.csv also eight census metropolitan areas. The official notes say estimates for Canada do not include the territories before 2018.
Statistics Canada Dissemination Geography Unique Identifier for the geography.
Population group as published: all persons, age groups, Men+ and Women+, and economic family types. Men+ and Women+ include some non-binary persons. Before 2021 this was the sex of the person.

Low income line as published: Low income measure after tax (LIM-AT), Low income cut-offs after tax and before tax (1992 base), or the Market Basket Measure on its 2000, 2008, 2018 or 2023 base. The Market Basket Measure is Canada's Official Poverty Line.

The kind of official figure. In low_income_statistics.csv: number of persons in low income, percentage of persons in low income, or average gap ratio. In income_deciles.csv: upper income limit, share of income, or average income.
Unit of measure for value, as published: Number, Percent or 2024 constant dollars.
Statistics Canada numeric code for the unit of measure.
Scale of value as published. In these tables the official scale is units, so values are already in persons, percent, dollars or Gini points.
Statistics Canada numeric code for the scalar factor.
Statistics Canada vector identifier for the series. Useful if you want to pull the same series again.
Statistics Canada coordinate string that locates the series inside the official table.
The published value. Empty when Statistics Canada did not publish a figure for that cell (see status). Official values were not altered. Gini coefficients run from 0 (equal) to 1 (unequal).

Statistics Canada status symbol. A to E are data quality grades based on the coefficient of variation (A excellent, B very good, C good, D acceptable, E use with caution) and come with a published value. F means too unreliable to be published and .. means not available for that reference period; in both cases value is empty. Empty status means no grade was given.
Additional Statistics Canada symbol when present, otherwise empty.
t if Statistics Canada has terminated this series, otherwise empty.
